name: Adam And Eve
overview: Scripture reveals that God created man in His own image, granting Adam dominion over the earth and commanding him to be fruitful and multiply, as seen in Genesis 1:26 and 1:28. God formed Adam from the dust and breathed life into him, establishing the beginning of humanity (Genesis 2:7). Though given freedom to eat from every tree in the garden, Adam and Eve disobeyed God's command by eating the forbidden fruit after the serpent's subtle temptation (Genesis 2:16; 3:1, 3:6). This act of disobedience marks the entrance of sin into the world and sets the stage for the human story that unfolds from their family life.
